integrity: One self-contained proof with a reproducible numerical cross-check; no independent mathematical audit.
scientific_limitations: The cycle-wise conditional endpoint rate is not actual reset work, physical heat, full trajectory entropy, or stationary-mixture divergence; no multidimensional or arbitrary-renewal theorem. The singular q=0 endpoint is excluded. Publication priority has residual literature risks.
scope: One-dimensional Ornstein–Uhlenbeck process with independent Gaussian resets at Poisson times, 0<q<1; unique optimizer and two sharp endpoint-width asymptotics for a conditional Jeffreys rate.
title: A unique Poisson-reset optimum and sharp temperature-contrast scales for Gaussian endpoint divergence
